rows.en: Geez… You sure work people hard!
So, how did it go? Did you find it?
Hehehe… About half of it got burnt, but hey! This is what you wanted, right?

…!?

Well done! With these research materials, the plan itself won't be hindered!

Uh-uh…

I'm not handing this over for free! Missy…
What!? Test subject 008, what's the meaning of this?
I'm saying I won't hand it over unless you make me and Kaori into a stronger type!

Kuh…

You insolent wretch! You dare defy us, the Battle Fleet Nation Naager!?
Whoa…
Hand over the research materials!
Damn… Satoru! You gonna get in my way!?
I said hand over the research materials!

Uoooh…

O-okay, okay… so don't get so mad! Here…

Test subject 008… For 005's sake, I won't punish you today!

But… I won't tolerate behavior like this ever again!
Tch…
Kaori!!
Test subject 009… what happened? Don't tell me 004 did this to you?

Ugh…

The prototype Gigant seems to still need improvement… It didn't seem able to lock on to its targets.

And… test subject 004 had already awakened!

What's more… into a type stronger than us…

What!?

Him? Awakened? A type stronger than us!?

Test subject 004 has awakened!?

So early…

Months earlier than planned… What happened? Are Dr. Hinata's Vol cells different from Naager's Vol!?

Damn…

Hey! Kaori's awakened! And so has Satoru…! Why? Why haven't I awakened!?

You've been built as the most savage type of EATER…

Your growth has been made to lag behind the others to keep you from eating each other!
Eating each other?

The EATERs that will be your food are still few in number…

From these research materials, I intend to build the mass-production Gigants that will be that food!

If you start eating each other before then, that'd be a problem!

What? So that's how it is!?

Then… when I awaken, the first thing I'll do is devour test subject 004! I'll follow the same "scent of the beast" we have!
Are you all right!?
What happened? What's going on? How did this happen…

It happened in an instant…

A fire broke out in the lab… I tried desperately to stop her, but [HERO4] jumped into the flames too…

What…!?

Then… what about Dr. Hinata? And his assistant, Minoshima…?
I'm afraid…
No…
Ugh…
[HERO4]…! Don't die!!

Forgive me…

I was right there, and still it came to this…
[HERO4]… What a reckless thing to do!

I…

I couldn't save them… not Papa, not Minoshima… I… ugh… I…

That's enough…

I understand… [HERO4], I understand. You did your best!

I'm sorry I wasn't there for you at a time like this. I'll never leave your side again!

[HERO4]… I promise! I'll protect you!
Thank you…
[HERO4]…! Uoooooooh!!
[HERO4]… I'll protect you, no matter what!
Defeat the EATER!
Defeat all EATERs and Gigants!

"…!?

Wait a second… This conversation, this scene… I'm sure I've seen it somewhere…?"
What's wrong? You suddenly went all quiet… [HERO2], do you hate me?

"No… [HERO4]! It's me! It's [HERO2]!

Hey! Don't you understand? [HERO4]!"
You're acting weird, [HERO2]…
"That's it! I remember! This is that day, three years ago…"

Hey, hey…

Today's… riding club day, isn't it?

"That's right…

And you… go back home to get something you forgot, don't you?"
My big brother and the others are coming today too, right?

"No! [HERO4]… You can't go home!

If you go home, you'll get badly hurt!"
"[HERO4]…! Can't you understand what I'm saying?"

"…!?

A dimension distortion field…?

Is this that power!? [HERO4]…!"

Sigh… I shouldn't have taken it out of the school building after all!

But… I wanted to get it dry-cleaned. Can't be helped…
"[HERO4]! Don't go! Please! Don't go! [HERO4]!!"
"Wait! [HERO4]… Don't go! [HERO4]! Uoooooooh…!"
"Damn… What should I do? At this rate, [HERO4] will…"
K-Kaori…!?
Fufufu… So you're still alive?
I see…! The EATER three years ago was you, Kaori!

That's right…

But… I won't lose like I did three years ago! Valkyria and I have both gotten stronger!
Gikkyuiiin…

…!?

Stop it, Kaori… There's no reason at all for us to fight, is there?
You may not have one, but I do! A perfectly good reason!

…!?

Assistant Minoshima… You mean your father, Kaori? That must be a misunderstanding! Dr. Hinata would never do something like that!
The Gigants have been improved too! It won't go like it did before!

Kuh… Don't think you've won just because of this.

Naager will reach Earth soon enough! That will be the end of you…
Ah…

Fufufu… What a clever girl.

You meant to put on a little act, desperate to save your father, but it seems your plan fell through, hm?

A pity… but the dimension distortion field is nothing like some childish time machine!

Go back to the past and save your father? What beautiful love between parent and child… Fufufu… Hahaha…
So… this is reality after all?

Inside a dimension distortion field, time doesn't flow at a constant rate!

In other words… with a dimension distortion field, you can travel through space while hardly aging at all!
You mean absolute time doesn't exist?
That's right… In theory, you can go to the future, but not to the past.
Papa…

Oh my? No need to look so disappointed, is there?

Once the experiment is over, you'll be joining Dr. Hinata too…
Experiment…?
Test subjects 003 and 004… are the first mated pair of EATERs!
A mated pair? [HERO2] and me?
Fufufu… Artificially culturing Vol cells and breeding EATERs: that is my ultimate goal!

uncertain: U05698: お嬢さん rendered 'Missy' (Tatsuya mocking Atefarina).
U05713: NAAGERのヴォル written in Latin letters in the source; rendered 'Naager's Vol'.
U05715-U05717: 共噴い read as 共喰い (eating each other / cannibalism).
U05738-U05752: [HERO2]'s 『』 lines (inside the dimension distortion field, unheard by [HERO4]) rendered in double quotes.
U05760/U05762: speaker label is Valkyria but the voice is Kaori's; translated as her speech.
U05765: 'You meant to put on a little act' implies [HERO4] staged the scene; kept as stated.
